% Pattern: env/class/llncs. The class declares the environments. With no
% option envcountsame, each environment has its own counter.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
\documentclass{llncs}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
A theorem of the class.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
It holds.
\end{proof}
\begin{lemma}
A lemma of the class.
\end{lemma}
\end{document}
